basePrompt: Create a production source character sheet of Erwu for a watercolor garden game. FOUR neutral standing full-body views in exactly 2x2 equally sized cells: front, right-facing side profile, right-facing three-quarter toward camera, right-facing three-quarter away. Photo1 (cat standing at window) is the BODY identity authority, photo2 closeup is FACE authority, photo3 illustration is MEDIUM/style only, photo4 reclining is fur/body softness reference. Reconstruct natural level-ground standing anatomy from the window photo; do not reproduce raised front paws. Important corrections: moderately LONG torso between shoulder and hips, gentle nearly level back, not a compact barrel or domed bear rump. Soft slightly low belly, distinct naturally articulated legs with modest paws, head proportionate not tiny, long gently tapering plush tail NOT a short fox brush. Slimmer gently tapered face, soft cheeks without exaggerated British Shorthair jowls, small dark nose, golden olive eyes with calm open lids. Dense charcoal blue-grey fur, lying smoother on back, a little fluff at neck and belly, not uniformly puffed. Match real cat rather than breed stereotype. Restrained watercolor washes, subtle paper texture INSIDE painted cat, sparse soft drybrush edges, no repeated scales or leaf shaped fur. Muted warm overhead light, no orange rim, coat stays dark grey. All four views same individual and consistent anatomical scale. Neutral relaxed stance, all four paws resting. Each full figure comfortably inside its cell, no overlap. Flat uniform #E6E6E6 background, no paper texture on background, no floor, no shadows, no text, no props, no vegetation. Clean source cutout sheet. Large landscape image.
